commitResults.messageTitle: mark as done without the classes

commitResults.messageBody:
Task descriptions and completion states are managed separately in Dog,
which makes the data easy to desynchronize and leaves task behavior in the
command loop.

Introduce Task to own its description and completion state. Move both Java
classes into the dog package and update the run instructions to match. This
keeps each task's data and behavior together while satisfying the project
coding standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java changes need a consistent project-wide convention, but the rules are
not available to the agent between tasks.

Add a project-specific skill summarizing the authoritative SE-EDU rules and
mandate its use in AGENTS.md. This keeps future Java work consistent while
linking back to the maintained source.

Commit messages and branch names need consistent conventions across future
work.

Add a project-specific skill summarizing the SE-EDU Git rules and mandate its
use in AGENTS.md. This makes focused, reviewable history the default for
future repository changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Completed lvl 4 without inheritance for now
Add fail-fast console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody:
Chatbot changes need repeatable checks with visible input and output.
Ad hoc runs do not reliably expose regressions between increments.

Add a test-ui skill, an executable test plan, and a command-by-command
runner that stops at the first mismatch. Require agents to review the
plan and run the skill after code changes so failures remain visible.

The command loop mixes task operations with detailed output formatting.
This makes the workflow harder to scan and nests the nonempty list path.

Extract named display methods and guard the empty-list case early.
Follow the course guidance on logical structure and a single level of
abstraction without changing the console output or adding new classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate command routing from task operations
commitResults.messageBody:
The main loop still combines input, dispatch, index validation and task
mutation. Readers must hold all these details in mind at once.

Extract focused routing and status-update methods, and report command
errors at the loop boundary. Keep task state local and return its count
explicitly, following the course guidance on short methods and scope.

Deadline and event parsing repeat split, trim and validation logic.
The generic parts names and long creation method hide field meanings.

Extract task-specific creation methods and share required-field checks.
Name the parsed fields and centralize usage messages, following the
course guidance on duplication and names that explain their purpose.
Expand UI coverage for malformed and free-form date fields.
